## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed 208 image captures during April 2026. This activity represents the site’s recorded screening work for the month. The service should continue to maintain routine capture processes and review operational issues as they arise, so that activity remains consistent and any barriers to delivery are identified promptly.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. Graders recorded 1 ungradable image set, representing an ungradable_rate of 0.5 of captures. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording these issues will support follow-up and help identify whether equipment or workflow problems are contributing to images that cannot be graded.

## Grading

Grading identified 75 referable results. The median interval from image capture to grading was 2. This provides a summary measure of turnaround for the month and should be considered alongside image quality and referral activity. The site should continue to monitor grading outcomes and address any recurring operational issues through the appropriate service channels.
